manufacturer.name: Mighty Mule (GTO Access Systems)
manufacturer.note: US residential gate opener brand of GTO Access Systems, formerly GTO, Inc. Older documents carry the GTO name and an R<model>INST revision code; newer ones carry Mighty Mule. Serves its manuals as static PDFs from a WordPress uploads directory and keeps a manuals index - both registered as harvest targets. Two brands searched alongside it, Apollo and a GTO "Gate1", returned nothing of their own and are not recorded.

No mightymule.com URL for it surfaced. Not fetched - egress blocked.
